avis.titre: Super Find!!!  Love it.  Age 70 - and sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I’m 70 …… hardly a wrinkle on my face ( satay out of the sun ladies) I used to use all Clinique and their Clarifying lotion. Well, Non of their clarifying lotions work on 70 year old skin. It actually burns. But this is lovely!!! Feels so good and starting out with every other night. Take away the cotton balls - they soak up too much. I put a few drops directly on the area and spread it with my right ring finger ( don’t ever pull your skin!). Feels SO refreshing and clean. After it’s really had time to soak in and dry, I use some Clinique ( Dramatically different moistening lotion) - just a bit on the dry areas of my face. And neck. Love this! It’s already firming up the couple places I’m starting to see pores. Nose, inside of cheeks, bit on chin and on my forehead- not because of pores - but just because it feels so good! I’ll come back and add to post if anything changes.
Very impressed with this product. Elf consistently delivers quality at an affordable price point. My skin seems smoother after a week of use.

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel freshMakes my skin feel fresh
avis.texte: I love this stuff very good for the price! Tightnes my pores and is a good size bottle for the price iv had mine for months now and still have half a bottle left
Nice toner for a nice price. Didn't irritate my sensitive skin. Lasts a while! Will repurchase very similar to the glow recipe one but not a dupe. Good option if your on a budget!
I have dry skin & this helped my skin to hydrate and absorb more moisture. I’m not sure if it made a difference in my actual skin tone in evening it out. It smells good, not overwhelming toner scent.
My skin changed INSTANTLY after the first use. I absolutely love this toner!
Loved the product but the bottle was tiny. Too expensive for the amount you get
I have aging skin and tried many products. Best affordable skin care out there. My skin is glass and hydrated. My go to products ! Great for under make up as well!
I like it the result , very gentle with the skin. Give you a beautiful glow and moisturise at the same time.

Finde dieses Produkt sehr schön, es reinigt meine Haut pflegt meine Haut und ist nicht klebrig was ich ja meistens nicht mag. Wenn die Rückstände so ekelhaft klebrig sind… Kann ich weiterempfehlen und werde ich auch wieder kaufen.

avis.titre: Best value toner for dry skin.
avis.texte: I am very happy with this toner, it is perfect for my dry skin, leaving it clean, fresh, and toned without drying it out. Excellent value, works better than the more expensive brands I’ve used in the past.
If you’re looking for a toner with an important minimizer in it, this is a great product. I highly recommend it. I’ve been using it for a while now.

This product is amazing! I was using Fenty skin for the longest time however, it’s just to expensive now days an elf products are what I found, the toner leaves my skin so soft and it’s lightweight, I would recommend it!
I like this toner! Helped hydrate my skin and shrunk my pores. Absolutely love how pretty the bottle is too ✨

This review is for the e.l.f. Thirst Burst Pore-fecting Toner, Hydrating & Exfoliating for Face, Smooths, Plumps & Minimizes Pores, Infused with Salicylic Acid, Vegan & Cruelty-Free which currently costs $12.00 This toner is awesome. I had just run out of my usual toner and saw this one and I know e.l.f. has a great reputation, so I thought I'd try it. First off, you get a pretty big bottle for the price, which is great especially since toner is an everyday, 2x a day item. I found this toner to be really hydrating without being greasy or messing up anything else I put on after. I have oil/combination skin and it did not make it worse. I think this is also a great toner for the winter, when your skin gets dryer. I'm not a scientist so I can't test for ingredients or anything, but what it claims to have are great products. It's mild and gentle for a 2% BHA, and I guess that's because of the hibiscus. I honestly love this toner so far, I have been sing it for about two weeks, so hopefully it stays going strong. One tip: I know a lot of people apply toner with a cotton pad or ball - I don't. I just pour some in my hand, and then dip my other hand in it and then use both hands to spread it on my face. This uses way less toner, and that way you're not accidentally removing it as you put it on. After all, cotton is more absorbent than your skin.

I've been using this toner once a week for about 3 weeks now, too harsh for me to use daily. It goes on silky smooth, lightweight and dries quickly. I have sensitive skin and there is a mild tingle right after putting it on but goes away after a few seconds. No tightness, no sticky feeling, no face turning red from irritation. Before this toner I've tried a couple others. Never really saw or understood the benefits, I just felt like I was wiping water on my face. But this one I love and can clearly see and feel the difference! Since using this one I've noticed my moisturizer seems to lock in better and wake up with my face still feeling soft. My pores are less noticeable and have not had as many blackheads around my nose & chin. Great quality and value for the price, it's a 4oz bottle but only using once a week it should last me a long time.

avis.titre: Glowy skin in a bottle. I’m impressed
avis.texte: I waited a few days before writing this review cus I really wanted to see if it made a difference in my skin, & I can honestly say it does. I use this toner at night before bed, and I don’t rinse it off. When I wake up in the morning, my skin looks noticeably better… like a natural glow even before I wash my face. I’m not sure if it’s the hydration or the gentle exfoliation, but it leaves my skin looking smooth, fresh, and kind of radiant without makeup. I’ve definitely noticed a difference in how healthy my face looks. I also have sensitive skin and was a little nervous to try a toner with active ingredients, but I didn’t experience ANY redness, stinging, or flare-ups at all. That was a huge win for me. The formula feels gentle and calming, and I can tell there are hydrating ingredients in it cus my skin doesn’t feel tight or dry afterward, it actually feels soft and plump. Also, the bottle is so pretty! It has this soft, iridescent look to it that actually makes me want to keep it out on my shelf. It’s the kind of bottle you don’t feel like hiding in a drawer. Just really well-designed overall. I’d say this is 100% worth it, not just for the results, but for the full experience. I’m really happy I gave it a few days before reviewing cus now I can truly say, this is a product I’ll be keeping in my routine.

I’ve really enjoyed using the e.l.f. Thirst Burst Pore‑fecting Toner, it’s become a refreshing step in my skincare routine that genuinely feels effective and hydrating. Right away, the texture stood out: it’s lightweight and almost gel‑like, so it glides over my skin smoothly without any sticky or tight feeling. The scent is very mild and clean, which I appreciate because it never irritates my nose or skin, and there’s no heavy fragrance competing with my serums or moisturizer. What I love most is how this toner balances hydration with gentle exfoliation. The formula feels instantly cooling and plumping as I swipe it on, and over the past few weeks I’ve noticed my skin looks more even and refreshed. My pores appear a bit smaller and my overall texture feels smoother, especially on days when my skin tends to be dull or congested. The addition of salicylic acid works well for my combination skin: it helps keep breakouts at bay and gently exfoliates without ever drying me out, while the hydrating ingredients make my skin feel soft rather than stripped. I also like that it’s vegan and cruelty‑free, it aligns with my preference for skincare that feels kind to both skin and conscience. In terms of value for the price, I feel like this toner delivers a lot: it’s versatile enough to use morning and night, layers well under serums and moisturizers, and has noticeably improved the look and feel of my skin. This toner strikes a great balance of hydration, exfoliation, and pore‑smoothing

avis.titre: Literally the best skincare product I have used in a long time!!!!
avis.texte: Elf has been one of my favorite drugstore brands for years so I jumped at ordering the Thirst Burst Pore-fecting Toner as soon as I saw it. I used their makeup first for years and have tried a few of their skincare products and I have to say, I have never been disappointed despite previously being such a luxury brand snob. I have been waiting for years for there to be a dupe for a certain brand that also has a 2% BHA liquid exfoliant. That brand has become more and more expensive and though I have seen other liquid exfoliants pop up, I have literally waited for two decades for there to be one more affordable with salicylic acid. And the fact that it is Elf to make it, makes me so happy! It is a clear liquid and it works perfectly for the toner step. I follow it with an essence and then serum and moisturizer. I love how short the ingredient list is. I am allergic to niacinamide and it is in so much skincare these days but not in this one! My skin does not burn or turn red after use and since I have become very sensitive, I can say this is sensitive skin friendly! There are also hydrating ingredients so your skin doesn't dry out. And for the price!!! Are you kidding me, Elf!?!?! This product is better than I could have ever dreamed of! If you have oily skin, want to keep your pores clear and get rid of any congestion or texture, you need this!

Reviewing the Elf Toner. This is a top notch toner. First, I am completely confident in the quality of the product. The company is committed to providing its customers with well researched and excellent skin care. Then, they are also committed to sustainability and cruelty free production. So, before I even begin to apply this to my face, I have a high confidence level in it. It did not disappoint. It went on with a fingertip splash. It’s light, like water. It absorbed quickly. The residual tackiness absorbed a little bit later. It’s a pleasant pink color from the hibiscus. I’m incorporating it into my routine. I have some enlarged pores on my nose and cheeks, and I’m hoping that it will help conceal them.

Pros: the shimmery iridescent pink is beautiful. I like that this has BHA to help exfoliate and smooth my face. The hibiscus gives it a nice floral scent . It was hydrating and did not irritate my sensitive skin. It’s a good price point too Cons: It’s a bit thicker consistency than I am used to for toner. I used it second on my facial care routine but before my serum. It had stickiness to it and I tend to prefer more watery toners.

I love the ELF brand have been using other products from them this one will tone your face along with adding hydration. Simply use in morning and afternoon or whenever you need to clean your face. Absolutely amazing!

I really have been impressed with e.l.f. lately! And am really impressed by this e.l.f. Thirst Burst Pore-fecting Toner! I have fairly sensitive skin and have had no adverse reactions. I LOVE that this has 2% BHA in it - others on the market with this ingredient (and lots of similar ingredients) cost a lot more and do the same exact thing!! Super happy e.l.f. made this toner really well and really affordable! A little goes a long way, too! So this will last me a while! I like to use a cotton round after cleansing and wipe my full face. A lot of toners dry my skin out but this one actually makes my skin feel hydrated and plump! I’m genuinely impressed!!

I really like the new products ELF has come out with. I think they are great quality for the price. This toner was a bit too much for my dryer winter skin. I think it will work well in the summer but was a bit too drying given the season as well as that I use a retinol. It was quick and easy to apply. My biggest complaint on this was that there is no seal between the bottle and the cap. My bottle arrived with a loose cap and about 20% of the toner had leaked from the bottle... so not great.

I love this brand, A lot of their products work really well and they’re very affordable—this e.l.f. Thirst Burst pore-perfecting toner. It’s a great toner for hydration and light exfoliating. It leaves my skin feeling really soft and clean; it doesn’t have any sticky, heavy residue at all. It has a thin watery light consistency, so it rubs in easily and absorbs quickly. And the bottle is very pretty, It has a glowy pearl metallic-looking bottle. This is definitely a great buy and a new part of my skin care routine.

This is a toner which combines exfoliation, via salicylic acid, with hydration, via hibiscus and other moisturizing ingredients. It is a relatively small size for a toner, but the active ingredients might make it more of an occasional treatment product than an everyday toner so the small size might last a while. Pros: Combining moisture with exfoliation makes a lot of sense. Salicylic acid is one of the gentler acids and it neutralizes itself after a few minutes. The moisture will buffer any irritation. Salicylic acid is also good for clearing and preventing acne and blackheads. Sometimes overproduction of oil is exacerbated by harsh or drying products. So this is a salicylic acid product that will not dry your skin out or irritate it. Cons: This isn't going to be a neutral, everyday toner because it has active ingredients. You would probably need to keep a different, neutral toner on your shelf for regular use. While gentle, salicylic acid does not play well with others. It clashes with retinol and they need to be spaced out. It clashes with benzoyl peroxide, which is used by many people with acne. It neutralizes vitamin C so you might be able to use a vitamin C serum afterwards, but only after waiting for the acid to dry down and neutralize itself. While sometimes combined with glycolic acid in a peel that combination is too harsh for everyday. So this might be great every day for many people, especially people who use salicylic acid often. But for other people with dry or

The toner itself is a great balance of exfoliating and hydrating, which is not easy to find in one product. The texture feels lightweight and refreshing, and it leaves my skin looking smoother with a healthy dewy finish instead of feeling stripped. The sa helps keep pores clearer and reduces the look of congestion, but it still feels gentle enough to use consistently as long as you do not overdo it. It absorbs quickly and layers well under moisturizer without pilling a bit sticky. One note about shipping is that my box arrived crumpled and partially open, which was disappointing. The product inside was still usable, but it did not feel as clean or giftable when the packaging looked tampered with during transit. I would recommend better protective packaging for delivery, especially for skincare items.
I wasn't expecting it to be THIS small... I'm also coming to realize elf products aren't the greatest after loving them for years now.

avis.titre: Goes on smooth, no scent, good base for other makeup
avis.texte: I ordered this e.l.f. Thirst Burst Pore-fecting Toner for my wife and she has used it for abut a week now. She reports back: I really like this e.l.f. Toner. First, there is no scent to it, which I appreciate, since I don't want it competing with my other scents. I have been applying it with a cotton round and have been a little heavy with it to see if I experience any pilling with other products and I haven’t. That's makes it very flexible and allows me to use it as I'd expect. It dries quickly and leaves my face feeling smooth and soft, and ready for the next step in my regime. It felt nice and light and didn't cause any irritation or stinging, and I tend to have sensitive skin. The bottle is only 4.7 Fl Oz, but for just $12 I feel it is reasonable priced for what it does. It’s too soon to comment on the reduction of my pores but if I notice that it really makes a difference, I will definitely purchase again and upgrade my review to 5 stars.

Does anyone else remember when e.l.f. was like the super cheap makeup brand that you only bought when you needed to use something once or twice and didn't want to spend a fortune? This is not that e.l.f. anymore. Their stuff has come a LONG way, and I'm so so impressed by the quality of their products. I recently started using their makeup primer and setting spray and LOVE them both. When this toner popped up, I pretty quickly ordered it because I had faith that it would be good based on other recently-used products. I LOVE this toner. Truly. I've been using it for several weeks, and it's so good. I get really bad blackheads on my nose, and this stuff has eradicated almost all of them. I use it just at night right now (directions say twice a day, but I wanted to start out slow). It has pretty much no smell. Nothing perfumy or overwhelming. It goes on my face nicely with a cotton pad and soaks in quickly. Doesn't dry out my skin or cause a rash. I will 100% order this again!

avis.titre: Leaves my skin looking more even and luminous
avis.texte: I have been using this toner consistently, and am genuinely impressed with the results. As someone with combination skin, finding a product that hydrates without clogging pores can be tricky, but this one strikes the perfect balance. It leaves my cheeks comfortably moisturized while keeping my T‑zone clear and refreshed. The formula itself is beautiful. It is a shimmery pink liquid with a slightly thicker, more viscous texture. Instead of using a cotton pad, I shake a few drops directly into my palms and press it into my skin. It absorbs quickly and leaves my face feeling soft, smooth and prepped for the rest of my routine. Even with twice daily use, I have not experienced any irritation. What I have noticed is a healthy, radiant glow that makes my skin look more even and luminous overall. This toner has definitely earned a permanent spot on my shelf.

avis.titre: I really like the toner, I'm looking forward to the long-term benefits.
avis.texte: I'm a 50/50 fan of Elf. It's a hit or miss for me depending on the product. In this case the toner is a hit for me. First Impressions: - Silky feel of the toner, goes on smoothly and absorbed nicely into the skin - Decently priced for the product (4.7oz) compared to other drugstore brands, about the same price range. - I woke up and skin felt smoother - I wore it under makeup and my skin looked like it glowed a bit more - Makeup applied perfectly, no issues with pilling or separation. Overall I really like the toner, I'm looking forward to the long-term benefits.

avis.titre: Great value, feels good on the skin
avis.texte: ELF has great value skin care and makeup and this toner is one of them. It has a very very slight scent, almost unnoticeable which I like. To use you simply shake well to disperse the active ingredients and, after cleansing your face, you can either dispense some into your hands and pat onto your face or put into a cotton pad and wipe over your face and neck. Like most toners, it feels cool and refreshing and helps to remove any residue left after cleansing and “tone” the skin and close the pores before using moisturizer. I think it does as good a job as may of the higher priced brands for a fraction of the price.
